findings.reason: versioning is suspended: an overwritten or deleted state can't be restored
findings.remediation: Enable versioning, so an overwritten or deleted state can be restored.

findings.reason: key arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111111111111:key/0b1c2d3e-open-4000-8000-000000000003 allows kms:Decrypt to principals in any account (statement AllowDecryptAnywhere)
findings.remediation: Remove kms:Decrypt for Principal "*", or restrict it with aws:PrincipalAccount or aws:PrincipalOrgID.

findings.reason: bucket: BlockPublicAcls, IgnorePublicAcls, BlockPublicPolicy, RestrictPublicBuckets off
findings.remediation: Turn on all four public access block settings on the bucket and the account.

findings.reason: the bucket has no policy, so plain HTTP requests aren't denied
findings.remediation: Add a Deny for Principal "*", Action s3:*, the bucket and bucket/* resources, with Bool aws:SecureTransport false as the only condition.

findings.reason: plain HTTP isn't denied for s3:GetObject by anonymous, another account, the bucket's account, arn:aws:iam::111111111111:root
findings.remediation: Add a Deny for Principal "*", Action s3:*, the bucket and bucket/* resources, with Bool aws:SecureTransport false as the only condition.

findings.reason: lock held for 3d3h, over 24h
findings.remediation: Check that no run holds the lock, then release it with terraform force-unlock.

findings.reason: lock file is 3d0h old, over 24h
findings.remediation: Check that no run holds the lock, then release it with terraform force-unlock.

findings.reason: lineage 1a2b3c4d-0000-4000-8000-000000000002 is shared by tf-audit/app (s3://acme-audit-good/app/terraform.tfstate) and tf-audit/copy (s3://acme-audit-good/copy/terraform.tfstate)
findings.remediation: One of the states is a copy. Keep the one the unit applies to and archive the other.

findings.reason: lineage 1a2b3c4d-0000-4000-8000-000000000002 is shared by tf-audit/app (s3://acme-audit-good/app/terraform.tfstate) and tf-audit/copy (s3://acme-audit-good/copy/terraform.tfstate)
findings.remediation: One of the states is a copy. Keep the one the unit applies to and archive the other.

findings.reason: aws_iam_role arn:aws:iam::111111111111:role/acme-audit-app is managed by tf-audit/app (aws_iam_role.app) and tf-audit/copy (aws_iam_role.app) (matched on arn)
findings.remediation: Remove the resource from all but one state with terraform state rm, or a removed block.

findings.reason: default encryption is SSE-S3: anyone with s3:GetObject can read state, no key policy applies
findings.remediation: Set default encryption to SSE-KMS with a customer-managed key, so key policy controls who can decrypt state.

findings.reason: object ownership is ObjectWriter: ACLs are on
findings.remediation: Set object ownership to BucketOwnerEnforced, which turns ACLs off.

findings.reason: no replication: losing the region loses every state
findings.remediation: Configure cross-region replication to a versioned, KMS-encrypted bucket.

findings.reason: replica acme-audit-legacy-replica is in the same region; replica acme-audit-legacy-replica versioning is suspended; replica acme-audit-legacy-replica: default encryption is SSE-S3: anyone with s3:GetObject can read state, no key policy applies
findings.remediation: Configure cross-region replication to a versioned, KMS-encrypted bucket.

findings.reason: no lifecycle rule expires noncurrent versions of every state: they are kept forever
findings.remediation: Add a lifecycle rule with NoncurrentVersionExpiration of at least the policy's noncurrent_days.

findings.reason: noncurrent versions expire after 3 days, under 7: a bad apply found late can't be rolled back
findings.remediation: Add a lifecycle rule with NoncurrentVersionExpiration of at least the policy's noncurrent_days.

findings.reason: encrypted with an AWS owned key, not KMS; point-in-time recovery is off
findings.remediation: Turn on point-in-time recovery and encrypt the table with a KMS key.

findings.reason: no discovered unit resolves to this key
findings.remediation: Delete or archive the state, or add the unit that owns it to the scanned repos.

findings.reason: state in a discovered bucket that no unit uses
findings.remediation: Delete or archive the state, or add the unit that owns it to the scanned repos.

findings.reason: written by 1.5.7, older than the policy's 1.10
findings.remediation: Upgrade the unit's terraform or tofu to at least the policy's min_terraform_version.

findings.reason: no server access logging and no CloudTrail trail records S3 data events for the bucket
findings.remediation: Turn on server access logging or CloudTrail S3 data events for the bucket.

findings.reason: the policy has the RootAccess statement that terragrunt before 1.2 added
findings.remediation: Remove the RootAccess statement that terragrunt before 1.2 added; the account root has access through IAM.

findings.reason: locks with dynamodb_table acme-audit-locks-bad only
findings.remediation: Set use_lockfile = true: dynamodb_table is deprecated since Terraform 1.11. Keep both during the migration.

findings.reason: digest for s3://acme-audit-bad/gone/terraform.tfstate, which doesn't exist
findings.remediation: Delete the -md5 item: its state object no longer exists.

findings.reason: s3://acme-audit-good/planned/terraform.tfstate doesn't exist: never applied, or a wrong key
findings.remediation: Apply the unit, or fix its backend key.

findings.reason: the state manages no resources
findings.remediation: Destroy the unit's code and state, or check that the key is right.

findings.reason: hashicorp/aws 4.67.0 in .terraform.lock.hcl is older than the policy's 5.0
findings.remediation: Upgrade the provider in .terraform.lock.hcl with terraform init -upgrade.

findings.reason: state is 4.8 KiB, over the policy's 0.004 MiB
findings.remediation: Split the unit.

findings.reason: locks with both use_lockfile and dynamodb_table acme-audit-locks-good
findings.remediation: Both lock files and DynamoDB are configured, which is fine while migrating. Remove dynamodb_table afterwards.

findings.reason: sensitive-looking attributes stored in plain state: aws_db_instance.main (password); aws_iam_access_key.ci (secret, ses_smtp_password_v4); random_password.db (bcrypt_hash, result)
findings.remediation: Use write-only arguments or ephemeral resources, or keep the secret in a secrets manager.
